en.title: Maximum Final Index Avoiding a Forbidden Point
en.description:
You start at index 0. At step j you may move forward j cells or stay in place, for steps steps in total, and you must never stop at badIndex at any moment. Find the maximum final index. If the starting point itself is forbidden, there is no valid path, and this site outputs -1.

The standard input/output format was compiled by this site; added numeric bounds and the encoding for no-solution cases are explicitly marked and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing steps badIndex. Original bound: 1≤steps≤2000; the original bound on badIndex is missing, and on this site 0≤badIndex≤10^9.
hints: Moving at every step ends at the triangular number T; if some positive triangular prefix is the forbidden point, skip the first step and the answer is T−1; otherwise it is T. A forbidden starting point returns -1 separately.
